# refresh { #labdata.refresh }

```python
labdata.refresh(cfg=None, progress=True, **kwargs)
```

Rescan the repositories and store the catalog.

The python side of ``labdata refresh``. The rebuilt catalog is returned, so
a notebook cell shows what is there now.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**cfg**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Settings. Defaults to [](`labdata.config.Config.load`).

<code>[**progress**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[bool](`bool`)]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Show a progress bar, one step per repository. On by default: this is the one call that can take a while, and it is otherwise silent throughout.

<code>[****kwargs**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [{}]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Passed to [](`labdata.list`), so ``version=True`` and ``url=True`` work here too.

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} []{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   A [](`pandas.DataFrame`), as [](`labdata.list`) returns.

## Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

<code>[:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [[ImportError](`ImportError`)]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   If pandas is not installed.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
labdata.refresh()                  # with a progress bar
labdata.refresh(progress=False)    # without
```
